properties.summary: Cloudflare Radar's hijack detection lists event 173876 at confidence 12 (Cloudflare's high band is 8 and above), first seen 2026-11-20T13:50:45Z, last seen 2026-11-20T20:40:50Z, by 46 of Radar's 280 route-collector peers. Prefixes: 103.114.128.0/24, 103.213.105.0/24, 103.254.166.0/24. Cloudflare's evidence: irr new origin invalid, irr old origin invalid, rpki new origin invalid, rpki old origin invalid. Routing data alone doesn't tell a deliberate hijack (BO-H-4A) from an operator error (BO-H-4B) or a legitimate change the detector misreads (BO-H-4C). Reported by Cloudflare; Blackout does not assess intent.
